goal: Make governed reviews record the already-validated ai-codex-review verdict at the runner-pinned head without weakening verdict uniqueness, head binding, or fail-closed behavior.
prohibited_actions: Do not delete, disable, or exclude the Codex reviewer as a substitute for repair.
Do not relax single-terminal-verdict, pinned-head, extra-decision-line, or auto-void guards.
Do not perform database or production mutations.
assumptions: The ai-codex-review wrapper will expose an opt-in mode that prints its already-validated verdict as a strict terminal line.
The runner can bind that opt-in output to its own pinned head without trusting reviewer-supplied head text.
stop_conditions: Stop if integration would require accepting an unvalidated wrapper verdict.
Stop if issue 2244 is closed or another active branch already owns the same repair.
